parts.name: Cap
parts.Basic_description: This is the cap of a pen, made of plastic, cylindrical in shape, and designed to cover the pen tip.
parts.Functional_description: It protects the pen tip from drying out and prevents ink leakage when not in use.
parts.Movement_description: It can be removed or attached to the pen body by pulling or snapping into place.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the pen, made of plastic, elongated and cylindrical, housing the ink reservoir and writing tip.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the main structure of the pen, providing grip and containing the ink supply for writing.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during use, except for the writing tip which contacts the writing surface.
